sources: https://resnexus.com/resnexus/reservations/book/7B774E16-3DD2-4EDB-8B6D-908C6FB9887E (the county's ResNexus booking page, rendered in the headless browser 2026-11-11)

hookups.source: Le Sueur County facility page ('Our sites do not have water or sewer hookups, but we do have a dump station ... along with 5 water spigots throughout the campground.') + ResNexus listing ('RV Site with 50 Amp Electric Hookup' #6, #8, #22, #24; the rest '30 Amp'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 27 electric RV sites and one non-electric RV site, each on a large gravel pad, plus 3 primitive tent sites and a group site with four electric hookups.

sites.source: Le Sueur County facility page ('1 Group Camping Site with 4 Electric Hookups', '1 Non-Electric RV Site', '3 Primitive Tent Sites', '27 RV Sites with Electric Hookups', 'Each site comes with a large and spacious gravel pad') + 2026 rates PDF ('27 Electric Sites', '1 Non Electric Site'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: Le Sueur County facility page (2010 grant built 'Dump Station', 'Potable Water', 'A Shower House'; 'we do have a dump station located at the campground for our guests to use, along with 5 water spigots') + Rules and FAQ ('bath/shower house'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Booked on the county's ResNexus page or by phone; 2026 reservations opened April 1. Payment at booking is non-refundable.

booking.source: 2026 rates PDF ('Reservations open at 8:00am on April 1, 2026'; 'To make a reservation over the phone, please call 507-995-1161'; 'Weekend stays require a 2 night (Friday-Saturday) minimum stay'; 'Holiday weekends require a 3 night minimum stay'; 'Credit Card payment must be made at the time of reservation and is non-refundable.') + Rules and FAQ ('Length of stay: Seven days is the maximum stay.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Electric sites $35 a night Sunday-Thursday, $40 Friday-Saturday and holidays; the one non-electric RV site $30. Sixth consecutive night earns a seventh free.

fees.source: 2026 rates PDF ('27 Electric Sites: $40 night Fri-Sat/Holidays $35 night Sun-Thur'; '1 Non Electric Site: $30 night'; 'Stay for 6 nights, get your 7th night free.') + ResNexus listing (electric '$35.00 / night', non-electric '$30.00 / night' for a weeknight) + Rules and FAQ ('You may not have more than 6 guests per campsite unless from the same household.'), read 2026-11-11

note: Le Sueur County regional park on Lake Washington near Kasota. The campground is an open loop at the north edge of the park, set well back from the lakeshore; fishing dock and canoe/kayak launch in the park, public boat accesses within 2 miles. --Claude
summary: County page, 2026 rate sheet, rules and ResNexus read: 27 electric (four 50-amp: #6, #8, #22, #24) + 1 non-electric RV site, no water/sewer at sites, shower house, spigots, dump; $35 weekday / $40 weekend-holiday, non-electric $30 (fees added); ResNexus booking, weekend 2 / holiday 3-night minimums, 7-night max confirmed. Electric 50 added. Season not stated. Not waterfront kept.
flags: Phone: stored 507-357-8201 is the county parks office; the campground's own reservation line is 507-995-1161 ('Campground & Reservations: 507-995-1161', 2026 rates PDF; also on the ResNexus page). Suggest 507-995-1161. apply.py does not write phones.

Site count: the county gives 27 electric + 1 non-electric RV sites (and '35 Campsites' in its amenity list, counting tent/group sites); the ResNexus page lists only 25 RV sites (#1-#25, 24 electric + #18 non-electric). Count written as 28 RV sites from the county.
Season: not written. No published campground dates; ResNexus shows 'NO ARRIVALS' on every site in November 2026. 2026 reservations opened April 1.

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. On imagery the campground loop sits in open ground beside the county road at the north edge of the park, with farm fields and woods around it; the lakeshore is out of the 800 m frame.
